featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Kanika,
We’re truly sorry to hear about your experience. We understand how challenging it can be to manage personal responsibilities—especially as a new mother—and we completely respect the effort it takes to get to class despite difficult circumstances.

At the same time, our late-entry policy is something we apply consistently for all clients. It’s not meant to be unkind, but rather to preserve the flow of the workout, minimize disruptions once the class has started, and ensure the best experience for everyone in the room. featured_reviews.name: manoj kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
i am a  civil servant and a member of Anytime Fitness group for the last 5-6 years.what straightaway sets this gym chain  apart from others, is the flexibility it provides . you can step in the gym at any time of the day, wether it is early morning or mid night and do your stuff. another unique thing about this gym group is that, if one takes membership at one branch in any city and go on tour anywhere in india or abraod, one can also do one's routine in the group's outlet in that city. there are plenty of outlets of this group all across the country and also abroad.
Now coming specifically to Prabha Devi branch where i do my routine, its a branch with ample space. the quality of instruments is top notch, they were well maintained and hygenic.unlike the cults and other gyms of the world, where the entire focus is on aerobic, the anytime fitness branch of Proabha Devi is profiecient in all aspects of the training wether it is strength training hypertropy or outright aerobic.
Another nice Aspect about this place , are the well qualified trainers, who have  indepth knowledge and are always more than willingness to help out. I cannot help but make a special mention of Shri Umesh Pille( whose pic also i am sharing). lets me make it clear that he is not my personnel trainer ( i wish he was but alas governemnt servants can never afford one :)  ), but he is always there to help anyone. he has a eye for the detials specially the techincal aspects of lifts, be it a  a techincal error in the  lift or a error in the postion of the foot or the tightness of core while lifting weights, nothing escapes his watchful eyes. he did correct quite a few flaws in my squat and his mere presence behind me , while i do that sqauts, lets me lift 3-5 kg extra :).
i would safely recomend Anytime Fitness, specially their   Prabha devi branch  to anyone who wants to explore anything beyond the walks or aerobics, specially if someone wants to built up some strenght or muscle mass.
